title: Warm Roasted Japanese Chicken Chirashi
description: A dense and flavorful Japanese dish featuring roasted chicken, pecan nuts, and steamed leaf wraps, perfect for a date night dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, and brown sugar
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit
While the chicken is cooking, heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the chopped pecan nuts to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until fragrant
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips
To assemble the dish, place a few slices of the chicken onto a shiso leaf, top with a spoonful of the pecan nuts, and drizzle with the remaining marinade
